title: An Empirical Investigation of Robustness in Large Language Models under Tabular Distortions
abstract: arXiv:2601.05009v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Distortions are a natural consequence of tables collected from real-world sources, where scraping, extraction, or manual intervention can introduce semantic and structural inconsistencies. Humans can often identify and mentally correct such errors autonomously before reasoning over the data. In this work, we investigate whether Large Language Models (LLMs) possess a similar capability by evaluating them on 506 distorted table question answering (TQA) samples derived from canonical tables. Our findings reveal systematic weaknesses in current LLM pre-training paradigms, where models exhibit a strong inductive bias toward assuming tables are well-formed, often overlooking distortions or discarding inconsistent entries instead of repairing them. translated_title: 表格失真下大语言模型鲁棒性的实证研究
translated_abstract: 失真（Distortions）是从真实世界来源收集表格时的自然产物，网页抓取、信息提取或人工干预都可能引入语义和结构上的不一致。人类通常能够在对数据进行推理之前自主识别并在头脑中纠正此类错误。在这项工作中，我们通过在源自规范表格的506个失真表格问答（TQA）样本上评估大语言模型（LLM），研究其是否具备类似的能力。我们的发现揭示了当前LLM预训练范式中的系统性弱点：模型表现出强烈的归纳偏置，倾向于假设表格是格式良好的，往往忽略失真，或直接丢弃不一致的条目而非修复它们。即使是GPT-5.4和Opus-4.6这样的前沿模型，在失真条件下的准确率也仅达到68%。虽然失真感知提示（distortion-aware prompting）能在一定程度上缓解这些失败，但错误依然存在。通过轻量级……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 本文通过构建506个失真表格问答样本进行实证评估，首次系统揭示了大语言模型存在“假设表格格式良好”的归纳偏置——倾向于忽略失真或丢弃不一致条目而非主动修复，即使GPT-5.4、Opus-4.6等前沿模型在失真条件下准确率也仅有68%。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically reveals that current LLMs exhibit a strong inductive bias toward assuming tables are well-formed—overlooking distortions or discarding inconsistent entries rather than repairing them—with even frontier models like GPT-5.4 achieving only 68% accuracy on 506 distorted table QA samples.
